_what: Corrected analysis of the state-only vs state+RGB campaign.
_supersedes: the headline tables in results/rgb/state_plus_rgb/figures/README.md as first committed, which quoted the 5-episode eval only and binarised the camera verdict at a 30% median
_does_not_modify: No existing result JSON is written. Every source path is recorded per run under runs[*].sources.
_primary_metric: curves.episode_return, mean of the last 20 of 250 updates, each update already a mean over 128 parallel envs
_secondary_metric: pixel_ablation.json results.intact, deterministic eval of the final weights
_sd_convention: SAMPLE s.d. (ddof=1) everywhere in this file
_budget: 250 updates x 128 envs x 64 steps = 2,048,000 env steps

eval5.metric_note: the 5-episode JSONs stored per-episode reward/step only, so the episode-level pairing for this env uses reward/step, not the headline upright fraction (the re-evaluation stores both)
eval5.pseudoreplication_warning: Episodes within a seed share one trained policy, so these n pairs are NOT n independent replications. This test answers 'for these particular policies, does the extension score higher from the same initial states', which is the right question for the excluded-episode dispute. For generalisation across training runs use paired_by_seed (n=3).
